label: MRtrix3 fod2fixel
description:
Perform segmentation of continuous Fibre Orientation Distributions (FODs) to produce discrete fixels

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: save_afd
parameters.description: output the total Apparent Fibre Density per fixel (integral of FOD lobe)
parameters.usage: output the total Apparent Fibre Density per fixel (integral of FOD lobe) Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: save_peak_amp
parameters.description: output the amplitude of the FOD at the maximal peak per fixel
parameters.usage: output the amplitude of the FOD at the maximal peak per fixel Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: save_disp
parameters.description: output a measure of dispersion per fixel as the ratio between FOD lobe integral and maximal peak amplitude
parameters.usage: output a measure of dispersion per fixel as the ratio between FOD lobe integral and maximal peak amplitude Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: fmls_integral
parameters.description: threshold absolute numerical integral of positive FOD lobes. Any lobe for which the integral is smaller than this threshold will be discarded. Default: 0.
parameters.usage: threshold absolute numerical integral of positive FOD lobes. Any lobe for which the integral is smaller than this threshold will be discarded. Default: 0.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: fmls_peak_value
parameters.description: threshold peak amplitude of positive FOD lobes. Any lobe for which the maximal peak amplitude is smaller than this threshold will be discarded. Default: 0.1.
parameters.usage: threshold peak amplitude of positive FOD lobes. Any lobe for which the maximal peak amplitude is smaller than this threshold will be discarded. Default: 0.1.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: fmls_no_thresholds
parameters.description: disable all FOD lobe thresholding; every lobe where the FOD is positive will be retained.
parameters.usage: disable all FOD lobe thresholding; every lobe where the FOD is positive will be retained. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: fmls_lobe_merge_ratio
parameters.description: Specify the ratio between a given FOD amplitude sample between two lobes, and the smallest peak amplitude of the adjacent lobes, above which those lobes will be merged. This is the amplitude of the FOD at the 'bridge' point between the two lobes, divided by the peak amplitude of the smaller of the two adjoining lobes. A value of 1.0 will never merge two lobes into one; a value of 0.0 will always merge lobes unless they are bisected by a zero-valued crossing. Default: 1.
parameters.usage: Specify the ratio between a given FOD amplitude sample between two lobes, and the smallest peak amplitude of the adjacent lobes, above which those lobes will be merged. This is the amplitude of the FOD at the 'bridge' point between the two lobes, divided by the peak amplitude of the smaller of the two adjoining lobes. A value of 1.0 will never merge two lobes into one; a value of 0.0 will always merge lobes unless they are bisected by a zero-valued crossing. Default: 1.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: maxnum
parameters.description: maximum number of fixels to output for any particular voxel (default: no limit)
parameters.usage: maximum number of fixels to output for any particular voxel (default: no limit)  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nii
parameters.description: output the directions and index file in nii format (instead of the default mif)
parameters.usage: output the directions and index file in nii format (instead of the default mif) Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: dirpeak
parameters.description: define the fixel direction as that of the lobe's maximal peak as opposed to its weighted mean direction (the default)
parameters.usage: define the fixel direction as that of the lobe's maximal peak as opposed to its weighted mean direction (the default) Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.
